meta.title: Impermanent Loss vs Slippage — 5 DeFi risks explained fast
meta.description:
The five DeFi words that cost beginners the most money, explained in plain English in under a minute.

0:00 Impermanent Loss vs Slippage
0:12 Bridging vs Swapping
0:24 Wrapped vs Native
0:36 Liquid Staking vs Staking
0:48 Audit vs Safe

Educational only — not financial advice. Do your own research.

lines.text: impermanent loss hits you while you wait
slippage hits you the second you trade
one is a position, one is a moment
bridging moves a token to another chain
swapping trades it for a different token
bridges carry the bigger risk by far

segments.hook: why there are two of them

lines.text: wrapped is an IOU issued by someone
native is the real asset on its chain
an IOU is only as good as its issuer
liquid staking hands you a receipt token
that receipt can trade below the real thing
an audit checks the code at one moment
safe would mean nothing can go wrong
